notes: Zhu (邾; Q227007). Cliopatria starts the row in 750 and ends it in 405; the infobox gives 1046 and the pages keep the state (renamed Zou) alive to about 348 under Chu, so a years-only keyframe is added at the start and the last shape is held to 349. A vassal of Lu on the Zhu page ('Vassal under the State of Lu, which was its overlord'): any vassal_start for Zhu belongs to the Lu dossier. The page's dating of the Chu conquest conflicts with nothing else opened (Chu page 'about 348', SA table '4th century BCE'). Pages opened: Zhu (state) (thin: no capital, no area, no rulers), Chu (state), Spring and Autumn period. Not on any page: the capital (Yi is not mentioned), the Zhu-Song-Qi-Wey wars, the exact year of the rename, the year of the grant. The Qi dossier's reading that Xue and Pi (418) lay on Zhu's shape is not on the pages opened (the SA table lists them 'to Qi' with no location). Gazetteer: Zoucheng is not in places.jsonl; a 15 km disc at its coordinates is used.
